description: 50 independent five-stage review packets; links are unvisited research leads and NOT observed evidence.

english_definition_review.task: Independently consult a reliable dictionary for the EXACT selected sense and POS. Record actual observed evidence, date, source and reviewer; check false WordNet senses.

burmese_review.task: Independent natural Myanmar translation and sense alignment; record actual reviewer, evidence and date.

example_review.task: Independently check grammar, collocation, register and selected sense in the original example.

cefr_review.task: Independently establish sense-specific CEFR level with authoritative level-tagged source; re-tier or hold if unsupported.

audio_review.task: Only after editorial approval generate George and Emma audio, listen to both, and test physical iPhone Safari playback.
